what_this_is: The layers that are not a stream. Each is a release of an external dataset, so the question is never how old it is - it is whether it is still there, still the file we accepted, still carrying the attribution and licence under which we may show it, and whether anybody has looked lately for a newer release. A layer with no expiry must not be reported as fresh either: silence about it is indistinguishable from neglect, which is what this register exists to end.

layers.what: Generalised rivers, water bodies and built-up footprint from Natural Earth; no municipal boundaries.
layers.why_no_expiry: Generalised geographic features change independently of the live streams; review the dataset edition on the recorded calendar.

provenance_as_the_file_carries_it.attribution: Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data @ naturalearthdata.com (public domain).
provenance_as_the_file_carries_it.note: Rivers, lakes and the built-up footprint from Natural Earth 1:10m (public domain), clipped to the Belgrade window and simplified (Douglas-Peucker, eps 0.0004 deg). Generalised at 1:10 million: this is
provenance_as_the_file_carries_it.name: basemap-belgrade

layers.what: Dated modelled population per H3 cell, shown as schematic symbols at representative points; not a census, exact catchment or exposure estimate.
layers.why_no_expiry: it is a dated RELEASE of an external dataset. It becomes out of date when its publisher issues a new release, which is a thing to check for on a calendar, not a thing to infer from a file's modification time.

source.demographic_reference_period: Mixed source vintages; not established as a single census date.

provenance_as_the_file_carries_it.attribution: Kontur Population, Serbia resource release 2022-06-30, CC BY 4.0; filtered by BEOPS.
provenance_as_the_file_carries_it.note: Modelled population per H3 cell from the 2022-06-30 resource. Points are arithmetic means of supplied outer-ring vertices; symbols are schematic. Window and radius selections use those points, not administrative boundaries or exact population exposure.
provenance_as_the_file_carries_it.name: context-population
provenance_as_the_file_carries_it.resolution: H3 resolution 8; representative points displayed as schematic hexagons, not exact cell boundaries.
